before: The canonical edit API had no atomic element move, although shared journals already supported moveNode. The private adapter could insert and remove registered blocks without moving them.
after: The native move edit preserves descendant IDs and inherited namespace meaning and publishes existing namespace-binding and move effects. The private command moves registered containers in one native undo unit without touching payload records.
reason: The implementation uses existing moveNode and setNamespaceBinding journal effects. No shared fields, operation encodings, versions, or payload formats change. Existing lock and mode rules remain active in the private adapter.
